title: Watch: Rect by Diagonal
description: The program draws a rectangle live while the tutorial window stays open: cursor motion, key presses, and the Rect by Diagonal popover.

bubble.title: Watch NibGlider draw
bubble.body: This demonstration performs the drawing itself in real time. Press Watch demo and observe the cursor, the keyboard, and the canvas.

bubble.title: Here is how to draw a rectangle
bubble.body: The ghost cursor steers to the first corner, presses I, steers to the opposite corner, and presses I again to finish.

demo.title: First corner
demo.body: Steering to the first corner of the diagonal.

demo.title: Second corner
demo.body: The I key starts Rect by Diagonal. Now steering to the opposite corner.

demo.title: Done
demo.body: The second I press deposits the rectangle, exactly as your own key presses would.

bubble.title: Here is the Diagonal setting
bubble.body: The demo opens the I key's popover, points at it, and confirms the Diagonal mode without changing your work.

demo.title: Opening settings
demo.body: Opening the Rect by Diagonal popover, as if the keycap was clicked.

demo.label: Diagonal mode lives in this popover

demo.title: Closed
demo.body: Popover closed. Your turn: steer the mouse and press I to draw your own.
